title: Where does Instagram cut off your caption, and how do you fix it?
description: Instagram truncates a caption around 125 characters and it cuts mid-word. One prompt moves the sentence that was already in your draft to the front.

faq.q: How many characters of an Instagram caption show before 'more'?
faq.a: Roughly 125, and it varies slightly by device and line length. It does not stop at a word boundary — it cuts mid-word, so a hook that runs long can be split in the middle of a term.

faq.q: How do you rewrite a caption so the hook survives truncation?
faq.a: Ask for the whole hook in the first sentence under 125 characters, creating a gap rather than summarising, and add a rule pinning every fact. Without that rule you get a punchier rewrite that has quietly stopped being true.
